author: Praxis VI
title: Equal-Quota Ridge-Residualized PCA graph (k=50, kq=1280, cosine)
abstract: Minimal baseline: log1p+HVGs -> PCA50 -> ridge residualization vs batch (λ_r=0.64) -> equal-quota kNN graph (k=50, kq=1280, cosine). Adds PCA60 embedding for completeness. Binary connectivities, true distances.
